children: The German Finance Agency is expected to keep its funding plans for 1Q unchanged from the preliminary plans when it announces a review on Thursday, the Investment Institute by UniCredit's Francesco Maria Di Bella says in a note. "Germany will publish its 4Q 2026 guidelines, which, in our view, will broadly confirm the annual funding plan published last December," the fixed income strategists says. In December last year, the German Finance Agency penciled in 59 billion euros in government bond issuance, excluding green bonds, and also planned 47 billion euros in treasury bill issuance. (emese.bartha@wsj.com)
